description: The AI side of Search Console, as far as the API goes. Google's Search Analytics API has NO AI Overviews or AI Mode filter (`type` is web/image/video/news/discover/googleNews, and searchAppearance carries no AI value), and Google's own AI Overviews and AI Mode impression totals exist only in the Search Console UI's Generative AI report and its CSV export. But AI Mode searches ARE counted inside the ordinary web rows, and they are worded differently, so this reads the window's query+page rows and picks out the ones worded like prompts: follow_up ("and how do i prove it", "what about poland", "spain?"), chat_reply ("yes please", "you are making it up"), instruction ("give me the cheapest one", tracker prompts carrying answer directions), pasted_text (quiz and form questions, pasted paragraphs), agent_search (search operators, quoted fact-check probes, research keywords with "official" and a year) and long_prompt. Returns totals over named rows, the AI-style totals with their share of impressions, per-kind counts, and the top flagged rows by impressions with the reason each was flagged. PRECISION FIRST: ordinary long-tail searches are never flagged, so treat the count as a FLOOR on AI use, not a measurement of it, and never present it as Google's AI Overviews or AI Mode numbers. Named queries only (Google withholds rare ones). Cached for six hours. Requires a paid plan (Starter+).

days.description: Trailing window in days (1-480). Default 90. Window ends ~2 days ago (GSC lag).

domain.description: Bare domain, e.g. 'example.com'. Must match a connected GSC property.

name: gsc_ai_searches
